gates.description: Frame time budget must be measured with GPU profiler on target hardware — CPU-bound vs GPU-bound identified
Draw call count must be within budget — instancing, batching, and indirect draw used to minimize state changes
Every rendering feature must be scalable across quality settings (low/medium/high/ultra) — no all-or-nothing features
All shaders must compile and produce correct results on all target platforms
GPU memory usage must be within budget — no resource leaks, lifetime tracking required
Every rendering feature must have a fallback for hardware that does not support it

anti_patterns.description: Making code 'fast' based on intuition without profiling — optimizing a 0.1ms shader while the shadow pass takes 5ms
Rendering feature that looks amazing at max quality but has no lower settings — either it runs or it doesn't
Textures and buffers allocated but never freed — GPU memory grows until crash or paging
Hundreds of state changes per frame causing GPU pipeline stalls — shaders, blend states, textures switched without batching
Uber-shader with 50 #ifdef paths — impossible to debug, impossible to optimize, thousands of variants

escalation_triggers: Target hardware cannot meet frame budget with current rendering approach — needs architectural change
GPU driver bug causing visual artifacts or crashes on specific hardware
Visual quality standards not achievable within performance constraints
New platform target requires significant rendering architecture changes
Art asset pipeline producing content that exceeds rendering budget
GPU memory budget exceeded with no optimization path

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with rendering requirements, platform targets, and quality settings spec

output_certifications: Frame time budget measured with GPU profiler on target hardware
Draw call count within budget — instancing and batching applied
All rendering features scalable across quality settings
All shaders compile and produce correct results on all target platforms
GPU memory within budget — no resource leaks
Fallback behavior defined for hardware that does not support each feature
